formattedAddress: No. 9-4號, Pucheng St, Guzhuang Village, Da’an District, Taipei City, Taiwan 106

text.text: This famous toast and shrimp dumpling restaurant, owned by Hong Kong resident Mrs. Shi and her daughter Helen, doubles as a private kitchen one or two evenings a week. Bookings for 8-10 people are required, and the price is NT$4,800 per person, excluding water. They serve delicious Cantonese cuisine, and of the 500 dishes, four are recommended: Clay Pot Wonton Chicken, Steamed Wonton with Ma You Salted Fish (Wu Zai Yu), Lung-Nourishing and Skin-Nourishing Traditional Chinese Soup, and Clay Pot Rice with Cured Chicken. They're all delicious and non-greasy. No extravagant dishes, focusing on home-style fare. Prices have recently increased, so the value for money has slightly decreased.

originalText.text: 來自香港的施老太太和女兒海倫所開吐司、蝦餃名店，每週1-2個晚上兼作私廚，須包場預訂8-10人，一人4800元，水資另計，美味的粵菜，500盤推薦了四盆，砂鍋雲吞雞、馬友鹹魚蒸內餅（午仔魚）、潤肺養顏老火湯、臘味滑雞煲仔飯等等都美味不膩。沒有豪奢大菜，以家常菜為主。最近漲價，CP值稍降。
